summary: Retest of iteration 68's wiring fix passed: ExpenseTab.js now imports InvoicesTab and renderInvoice() returns <InvoicesTab />. The new InvoiceFormModal (with all expected data-testids) is now reachable and fully functional. Backend pytest re-run: 7/7 PASS. Frontend e2e flows: client selection + auto-populate ✓, Terms→Net 30 auto-updates Due Date ✓, item totals math (Sub Total ₹10,000 / Discount -₹1,000 / Taxable ₹9,000 / Tax +₹1,620 / Total ₹10,620) ✓ in UI, Save as Draft creates draft + toast ✓, Save and Send marks invoice as sent + dual toasts ✓, Clients tab cross-update ✓, View Summary modal shows last invoice date + invoice history ✓, Add Client INSIDE invoice modal works and new client appears in dropdown without modal reopen ✓. ONE NEW BACKEND BUG FOUND: when gst_type=='gst' (frontend default), backend ignores per-item discount and computes invoice-level GST on raw subtotal. Saved invoice total ₹11,800 (10,000*1.18) instead of the ₹10,620 shown in the UI total panel.

critical.issue: Per-item discount_percent is IGNORED when gst_type=='gst' (the frontend default). finance_routes.py lines 218-227: if invoice_data.gst_type == 'gst', backend recomputes total as `subtotal + cgst + sgst + igst` using full subtotal (no discount applied). For an item qty=2 rate=5000 disc=10 gst=18, the UI total panel correctly shows ₹10,620 but the persisted invoice total_amount is ₹11,800. Fix: use `(subtotal - total_discount)` as the base for invoice-level GST, OR drop the gst_type=='gst' branch and always use the per-item path (line 231: total = subtotal - total_discount + total_gst).

integration_issues.flow: Invoice total mismatch between UI and persisted invoice
integration_issues.issue: UI's Total panel computes correctly (₹10,620) but the row saved in DB shows ₹11,800. This is a backend issue (see backend_issues.critical) but it surfaces to the user as inconsistency: they hit Save as Draft expecting ₹10,620 and see ₹11,800 in the Invoice List + Client Summary Invoice History. rca of the issue: RCA of total-mismatch bug: finance_routes.py @create_invoice computes per-item discount and GST correctly into `total_discount` and `total_gst`, but at line 219-227 it branches on `gst_type == 'gst'` (default sent by frontend) and re-computes `total = subtotal + cgst + sgst + igst` where cgst/sgst/igst = (subtotal * invoice_data.gst_rate) / 100, completely discarding the per-item discount. Result: a 10% discount on a ₹10,000 subtotal with 18% GST is saved as ₹11,800 (= 10000 + 1800) instead of the correct ₹10,620 (= (10000-1000)*1.18). Reproduction: POST /api/finance/invoices with gst_type='gst', items=[{quantity:2, rate:5000, discount_percent:10, gst_rate:18}] → response total_amount=11800. Fix: change line 221 base to `(subtotal - total_discount)` or delete the gst_type branch and rely on line 231's per-item math which already produces the correct value.
